caption:
✍️ Semicolons have ONE main job

✅ Rule: A semicolon joins two complete sentences. (Its only other SAT use: separating list items that already contain commas.)
❌ The test was long, I finished early.
✅ The test was long; I finished early.
✅ Quick check: Can each side stand alone as a sentence? Then a semicolon works.
